notes: v2.5.40. The 3D viewer gets a familiar CAD mouse, edits in place, a tool pill, shaded opens and a tidier Details pane. New geometry tools measure parts exactly, export STEP, IGES, STL and 3MF, cut exact sections and compare revs. The eBOM gets a new release form, a full-screen release document, a document for every Released, plain status history, one-sheet Proc-Mat-Spec changes, and metadata edits that never wait for CATIA. A printer-first RP board, release hand-off to RP and CNC, CNC cards that act in place and only released parts on the CNC board. Profit follows recorded hours and the MS Project plan, with an On track view; Paycom hours follow each punch code. Badge and PIN sign-ins end cleanly, and a runaway conversion is stopped and held.
